definition: The system can carry an authorized point-in-time input state end to end and produce an immutable forecast artifact, or refuse in writing with a named code. It says nothing about model quality.

capabilities.name: resolve teams and players deterministically
capabilities.evidence: pff_id and nfl_id cover 100% of the 1,126-player WR/TE/RB frame; no fuzzy matching anywhere

capabilities.name: retrieve and validate authorized source data
generate player-level football distributions
capabilities.gap: QB layer is BASELINED (audited, not decomposed); production uses a shrinkage baseline

capabilities.name: generate joint draw artifacts
capabilities.gap: dependence structure is neutral where unsupported, by design

capabilities.name: deterministic fantasy scoring as a downstream view
refuse output on provenance or integrity failure

publication_gate.no_auto_authorization: There is no path from a green test suite, a discharged checklist, an environment variable or a caller flag to AUTHORIZED.

does_not_assert: that a dry run is prospective evidence
